## Comparison: Workday FY2027 Q1 Guidance vs. Actual Results

**Guidance (issued in Q4 FY2026 earnings release, filed 2026-02-24):**
"Workday is providing guidance for the fiscal 2027 first quarter ending April 30, 2026 as follows: Subscription revenues of $2.335 billion, representing growth of 13%. Non-GAAP operating margin of 30.5%." [DOC: workday_guidance.txt]

**Actual results (Q1 FY2027 earnings release, filed 2026-05-21, period ended April 30, 2026):**
"Subscription revenues were $2.354 billion, an increase of 14.3% year-over-year. Non-GAAP operating income for the first quarter was $809 million, or 31.8% of revenues." [DOC: workday_actual.txt]

**Metric-by-metric assessment:**

1. **Subscription revenue:** Guided at $2.335B (13% growth); actual came in at $2.354B (14.3% growth) — a beat of roughly $19M (~0.8% above guidance), and growth rate exceeded the guided 13% by 1.3 percentage points. **Beat.**

2. **Non-GAAP operating margin:** Guided at 30.5%; actual was 31.8% — a beat of 1.3 percentage points. **Beat.**

Both periods being compared are the same fiscal quarter (Q1 FY2027, ended April 30, 2026) reported on a consistent non-GAAP/GAAP basis as defined by Workday in both releases, so the guidance and actual figures are directly comparable — no divestiture, spinoff, or segment redefinition issues are indicated in the excerpts.

ANSWER: Workday beat its own guidance on both metrics for Q1 FY2027: subscription revenue of $2.354B vs. guided $2.335B (14.3% actual growth vs. 13% guided), and non-GAAP operating margin of 31.8% vs. guided 30.5% (a 1.3-point beat).
